messages:
melanie: Heads-up — starting next week we're rolling out 'redwood-ci' (CLI + org-wide reusable GitHub Actions workflows) to standardize CI across repos. The goal: remove per-repo pipeline YAML drift and make rollouts predictable. Docs: https://docs.internal.redwood/re/redwood-ci (WIP)

ajohnson: Nice — does this force a migration? what's the timeline?

melanie: Short answer: yes we'll deprecate old per-repo pipelines but staggered. Timeline: week 1 — canary (team: apps/*), week 3 — opt-in for teams, week 7 — org policy enforcement (block pushes to main if no reusable workflow). We'll send calendar invites.

raj_s: How are secrets handled? will we centralize? any change to ARN names?

melanie: Secrets remain repo-level for now. 'redwood-ci' exposes a standard set of env var names. We'll provide a migration script to copy secrets to new names and a CLI check: `redwood-ci check-secrets`.

lisa_k: Can we get help migrating 3rd-party actions we rely on? some repos use custom docker build steps.

tomas: Infra note: custom steps keep working — reusable workflows wrap them. If a repo uses self-hosted runners you'll be fine. For weird/old GH Actions we added a compatibility shim. We also added a `--preview` flag so you can validate without enforcement.

devex-bot: Docs updated: https://docs.internal.redwood/re/redwood-ci/migration-guide

melanie: Sample usage:
```
# run local lint/test using redwood-ci
redwood-ci run --repo=redwood/app-portal --workflow=ci.yml --preview
```

ajohnson: Will this change billing/runner assignment?

tomas: No immediate billing change. But we will start routing heavy workloads to dedicated pools via labels `redwood-dedicated` later this quarter.

raj_s: Will org-level OIDC policies change? service accounts?

melanie: OIDC stays same. We will require tokenless runners for new org policies in phase 2 — we'll give a migration playbook.

infra-bot: Canaries flagged: apps/auth-service, apps/portal-service, infra/ci-templates — watch for failed runs. (automation)

lisa_k: Thanks — can you post the migration sheet + pairing slots?

melanie: Yep — shared sheet + signup: https://cal.internal/redwood-ci-migrations. Pairing slots tomorrow 3pm-5pm PT and Friday.

tomas: If you'd like to test, tag me `@tomas` and I'll add your repo to canary. Also run `redwood-ci lint` to validate workflow YAML.

melanie: We'll do a formal all-hands recap Friday. Ping me with any blockers. :sparkles:
